# Vector2Int

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework` · struct

```csharp
public readonly struct Vector2Int : IEquatable<Vector2Int>
```

A position or size in whole numbers: pixels, usually. It's an immutable value, and converts implicitly to `Vector2`.

## Constructors

